text:
Maria K: Hey team — Evora interview went well. They agreed to a short launch quote and to share perf numbers for our benchmark chart. Need to lock recording, legal ok, and a handoff to SDRs for inbound routing. Timeline: want assets by next Wed.

Jonah P: Nice. Can we do a quick storyboard for the launch post + a 30-min customer webinar? Suggested creds: benchmarking slides, 1-min customer clip, 3 quote pullouts.

Maria K: Yep. Storyboard idea: 1) problem, 2) benchmark highlights (latency/cost), 3) how Evora integrated, 4) results + CTA. I'll draft.

Selina L: Send me the proposed quote text and the exact benchmark numbers before we publish. Need opt-in from Evora legal for the numbers and a short quote release form.

Tom S: I'll handle SDR routing. Once we have final release date + a plain-language TL;DR, I can build a lead nurture flow and tag leads with "evora-launch". Any gating on demo invites (open vs invite-only)?

Maria K: Evora prefers invite-only for first two weeks. We should route inbound to SDRs and prioritize customers in our pipeline. Tom — can you prioritize enterprise MQLs?

Tom S: Yep. I'll create a static list and a webhook to the Playbook. Also want the webinar recording hosted on our gated page so we can capture contact info.

Priya R: I confirmed with the customer: they're OK with the benchmark numbers but asked we don't publish raw p95 numbers for internal configs. They gave a permissive summary: "~3x throughput at 60% lower cost vs. prior setup" — that's their preferred phrasing.

Jonah P: Perfect — that phrasing reads well. I put a sample pull quote into the doc: "Evora saw ~3x throughput and 60% lower inference cost after rolling to Redwood Dedicated." Will add citation note.

Selina L: Redlines: change "60% lower cost" -> "up to 60% lower cost"; add signoff line for customer: "Evora Inc. grants Redwood permission to use the above quote and summarized performance claims for marketing purposes." I can draft the short release form.

Maria K: OK — Jonah, update assets. Selina, can you run the release form by Evora legal? I can send them the Doc and a calendar invite for signatures.

Selina L: On it. I'll ping Evora legal now and ask for approval by EOD Friday. If they ask for more precise numbers, we offer the summary language only.

deploy-bot: Recording slot created: 
- Meeting: Evora Customer Interview
- When: 2024-06-12 14:00 PT
- Link: https://meet.company/evora-interview (owner: Maria K)

Maria K: Thanks bot. Jonah — can you assemble a 2-slide benchmark visual + one customer headshot by Mon so I can review before legal signs off?

Jonah P: Will do. I'll drop a PNG and a PPTX in the /marketing/evora/ drive and ping here.

Tom S: One ask for the SDR workflow: include a short qualification note in the lead payload: "interested_in=dedicated,preferred_demo=invite-only" so we can tag sequences correctly.

Maria K: Good call. Add that to the handoff doc. Also planning: embargo until launch date (TBD) — propose 2024-06-20 to give evora a week to prepare customers. Thoughts?

Priya R: Evora asked for a Monday launch. 2024-06-24 would give them two weeks. They prefer 06/24.

Selina L: 06/24 works for legal timeline. I'll aim to get release signed by 06/14.

Maria K: Great. Action list: Jonah — slides + assets by Mon. Selina — release form to Evora legal (EOD Fri). Tom — prepare SDR routing + lead tags. I'll draft launch copy and the webinar invite. Ping here once items are done. :thumbsup:

Jonah P: Done, uploaded first-pass slides. Link: drive.google.com/evora-assets. 

Tom S: SDR webhook is ready. I'll do a smoke test once we have the final lead copy.

Selina L: Evora legal requested one small change: change "Redwood Dedicated" -> "Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity)" in the quote. They signed off otherwise. Sending signed doc now.

Maria K: Received signed doc. Thanks Selina. Jonah — update slide caption. Tom — I'll send demo invite list to you Wed.

Jonah P: Caption updated and new PNG uploaded.

Tom S: Got the demo invite list. Building sequence now. 

Maria K: Wrapping: prep notes for launch playbook in /marketing/playbooks/evora-launch.md. I'll share draft for review tomorrow. Thanks team! :party_popper:
